correctness.rationale: The identity f(w-1)+1=-w-2/w holds exactly on the full stated domain; induction gives sign alternation, global existence, and t_(n+1)=t_n+4+4/t_n. Monotone bounds yield t_n=4n+O(log n); then the series of terms 4/t_k-1/k converges absolutely at O(log k/k^2), proving the stated constant and o(1) remainder. Strict t increase excludes periodic orbits; compact exhaustion and dominated convergence exclude all invariant Borel probabilities. A standalone rational checker tests the algebra independently.

value.rationale: The original article labels its exact map numerically aperiodic and reports unbounded oscillations. The theorem resolves the global fate of every admissible orbit, gives an exact alternating route to infinity and a sharp, universal 4n+log n escape clock, and classifies invariant probability measures. The logarithmic term is a meaningful fine dynamic invariant distinguishing parabolic drift from linear or exponential escape, beyond a simple renaming or finite experiment.
